title: Fig. 3 G-4C Overvisor Space Helmet photo; Fig. 4 G-4C Extravehicular Suit layer diagram
description: Page from NASA document M-913-65-04 (6/1/65). Fig. 3 is a photograph of a person wearing the "G-4C OVERVISOR SPACE HELMET" with a dark reflective visor. Fig. 4, titled "G-4C EXTRAVEHICULAR SUIT", is an exploded diagram of the suit's material layers grouped as "THERMAL AND MICROMETEOROID LAYERS" and "PRESSURE AND RESTRAINT LAYERS", with small labels for each fabric layer.
